description: This file contains implementations of exponential and logarithmic functions for rational numbers, including Taylor series approximations, power calculations, and scaling techniques. It defines functions such as exprat, lograt, and powrat, and handles rational number manipulations and special cases.

methods.name: _exprat
methods.description: Computes the exponential of a rational number using Taylor series approximation, with specified precision.

methods.name: exprat
methods.description: Calculates the exponential of a rational number, handling large values and scaling, with support for different radices.

methods.name: _lograt
methods.description: Computes the natural logarithm of a rational number using Taylor series approximation, with scaling to prevent explosion.

methods.name: lograt
methods.description: Calculates the natural logarithm of a rational number, including scaling for large or small values.

methods.name: log10rat
methods.description: Calculates the base-10 logarithm of a rational number by dividing the natural log by ln(10).

methods.name: IsEven
methods.description: Determines if a rational number represents an even integer, assuming denominator is 1.

methods.name: powrat
methods.description: Calculates the power of a rational number raised to another rational exponent, handling special cases and fractional exponents.

methods.name: powratNumeratorDenominator
methods.description: Handles power calculations when the exponent is expressed as a numerator/denominator rational, applying power rules.

methods.name: powratcomp
methods.description: Performs the core power calculation using x^y = e(y * ln(x)), with special handling for integer exponents.
